The '''PY-6 Proton Torpedo Site''' was an anti-[[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]]/[[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] ground emplacement weapon, consisting of a massive barrage style array of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] tubes. It was designed to engage enemy [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] and prevent them from moving into position to begin an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]]. It was large and hard to conceal, but was capable of inflicting massive amounts of damage on attacking fleets by firing hundreds of torpedoes into orbit. The weapon required a crew of four to operate.<ref name="HS" />
